metadata.host_uname: Linux Debian-trixie-latest-amd64-base.zst 6.12.94+deb13-amd64 #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Debian 6.12.94-1 (2026-06-20) x86_64 GNU/Linux
metadata.kernel_units: aggregate workload iterations per million TSC ticks; three boots in repetition order
metadata.kernel_configuration: Release MCS, 6 vCPUs, PCID off, skim window off, FSGSBASE via MSRs, printing outside the measured windows. Benchmark source is fl4test/perf.c.
metadata.linux_configuration: Issue #11 Linux ELF, initramfs, benchmark binary, and per-backend l4h root task reused unchanged. FL4 variants change only the kernel image. One full warmup suite precedes each measured suite.
metadata.linux_samples: Arrays in repetition order, five fresh boots. Rates = operations * 1e9 / elapsed_ns; latency = elapsed_ns / operations / 1000. Both warmup and measured phases retained.
metadata.linux_workloads: 200M compute iterations, 200k real getpid syscalls, 8192 fresh 4 KiB page faults with MADV_NOHUGEPAGE, 200 fork/exit/wait cycles per worker. IPC is one pinned process pair with 100 warmup and 10000 measured round trips, on one CPU or across CPUs 0 and 1.
metadata.limitations: One KVM layer, pinned physical cores but no OS isolation, powersave governor with boost enabled. Sequential runs; no concurrent builds or benchmarks. Kernel benchmark uses upstream seL4, Linux uses the issue's l4h-patched seL4. No measured samples discarded. Historical and diagnostic runs are separate from this final comparison.
metadata.primitive_samples: Three fresh boots; trials 0 (warmup) and 1-5 (measured) retained. Per-operation microseconds = ticks / operations / 3792.848570. Split-path timing is instrumented and not additive.

retry_diagnostics.method: Temporary per-core counters and RDTSC phase instrumentation, accumulated over the whole Linux suite including boot, warmup and measurement. One boot per cell. Diagnostic timing and retry rates are invasive; not final performance samples.
